snippet.title: Periods Every Three Months: No Risk of Pregnancy? #Shorts
snippet.description:
Irregular periods while on a weight-loss injection: "I'm not going to get pregnant"? Your body ovulates first, and the period comes later, so a pregnancy can happen when you least expect it. There are not enough human data to say these medications are safe during pregnancy; effective contraception is essential during treatment and during each drug's washout period. Dr Senai Aksoy explains.

▶ Full video: https://youtu.be/Q7aCrXhG_E8

This content is for information only. It does not replace an individual medical evaluation.
English-dubbed version with an AI voice based on Dr Aksoy's own voice; AI-assisted lip synchronization.
